title: Unit econ: add daily aggregation job for blended $/1M output tokens (model/region/tier)
author: Nadia Rahman
body: Context: This PR adds the first canonical daily unit economics aggregate used by the internal Unit Economics dashboard. The dataset produces blended cost as $/1M output tokens with drilldowns by model, region, and customer tier (self_serve/dedicated/private/enterprise). This is the MVP grain discussed for ENG-2910 (daily partitions; no per-customer slices) and is intended to reconcile to metering/billing within Finance’s agreed tolerance (see PM-483 for acceptance criteria). What’s included: (1) New scheduled job `unit_econ_daily_agg` that reads token-level metering + cost attribution events, aggregates by day (UTC), model_variant, region, and customer_tier, and writes to `analytics.unit_econ_daily_v1` partitioned by `ds`. (2) A stable schema + data contract comments (column docs + expected units). (3) Tests: deterministic golden test on a fixed synthetic day with mixed tiers/regions + property-based checks on aggregation invariants (e.g., cost_per_1m = blended_cost_usd * 1e6 / output_tokens, null handling, and zero-token safeguards). Metric definition (as implemented): - output_tokens: sum of `metered.output_tokens` after dedupe (request_id, seq_no). - blended_cost_usd: sum of `cost_attrib.total_cost_usd` (compute + allocated overhead) at request granularity rolled up to day. - cost_per_1m_output_tokens_usd: CASE WHEN output_tokens > 0 THEN blended_cost_usd * 1e6 / output_tokens ELSE NULL END. Dimensions: - model_variant: normalized from runtime `model_id` using `dim_model_catalog` (falls back to raw model_id if unmapped; flagged in `unmapped_model_id_count`). - region: from `edge_region` (normalized to canonical region strings; e.g., us-east-1, eu-west-1). - customer_tier: derived via join to `dim_customer_tier_history` on account_id + effective_at, so historical tier changes are respected. Late-arriving data: For now, the job recomputes the last 3 partitions on each run (ds-2, ds-1, ds) to absorb late metering/cost events. This window is configurable (`UNIT_ECON_RECOMPUTE_DAYS`, default 3). Backfills beyond that are intentionally out of scope for this PR and will be handled via the backfill tooling/runbook workstream. Guardrails / cardinality: This job enforces the MVP grain by refusing to emit additional dimensions (route/runtime_config/quantization_profile are intentionally not included yet). The query groups strictly on (ds, model_variant, region, customer_tier). Any additional high-cardinality tags present upstream are ignored. Schema (analytics.unit_econ_daily_v1): - ds (DATE, partition key, UTC) - model_variant (STRING) - region (STRING) - customer_tier (STRING) - output_tokens (BIGINT) - input_tokens (BIGINT) - request_count (BIGINT) - blended_cost_usd (DOUBLE) - cost_per_1m_output_tokens_usd (DOUBLE) - cache_savings_estimate_usd (DOUBLE, currently 0.0 placeholder; wired in future PR) - unmapped_model_id_count (BIGINT) - data_completeness_pct (DOUBLE; based on metering->cost join success) - job_run_id (STRING) Notes: - This is a curated aggregate for dashboarding; it is NOT the billing source of truth. - We exclude internal load tests (`traffic_type = 'synthetic'`) and any requests flagged as `is_free_trial = true` in the metering stream (these are still metered elsewhere; excluded here per current Finance guidance). - Credits/discount presentation is explicitly deferred; this dataset is cost-side only. Implementation notes: The aggregation uses a two-step approach: first dedupe/normalize metering events to request-level, then join to request-level cost attribution, then aggregate to daily dims. This avoids double-counting where multiple metering events per request can occur with streaming. An illustrative snippet from the core SQL (simplified): SELECT ds, model_variant, region, customer_tier, SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens, SUM(total_cost_usd) AS blended_cost_usd, (SUM(total_cost_usd) * 1e6) / NULLIF(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS cost_per_1m_output_tokens_usd FROM request_cost_enriched GROUP BY 1,2,3,4; Validation: Added a reconciliation helper query used by the tests to compare daily totals to raw metering totals within 0.1% on synthetic fixtures. Real tie-out to billing hooks will be added in the reconciliation job PR. Follow-ups (not in this PR): - Add cache hit-rate + estimated savings attribution (ENG-2913). - Add quantization_profile and runtime_config slicing (ENG-2912) after cardinality review. - Add automated billing reconciliation and alerting (ENG-2914). Rollout: Job is behind a scheduler flag `enable_unit_econ_daily_v1` and will initially run in dry-run mode for 48h (writes to staging table) before flipping to prod table in the next deploy window.
commits: analytics/unit_econ: add daily aggregation job skeleton + scheduler wiring
analytics/unit_econ: implement request-level dedupe + tier history join
analytics/unit_econ: add unit_econ_daily_v1 schema + table DDL
analytics/unit_econ: add golden tests + aggregation invariants
docs: add dataset readme + owner metadata
conversation: Logan Wright (review): Can we ensure the tier join is historically correct (effective_at <= request_ts < next_effective_at) and add a test that catches tier flips mid-week? Nadia Rahman (author): Updated dim_customer_tier_history join to use valid_from/valid_to semantics and added a fixture with a tier flip; golden test now asserts both tiers appear on the same ds. Rishi Malhotra (review): Please clarify exclusions: are free credits/discounts included in blended? Also, confirm we’re excluding synthetic traffic. Nadia Rahman: This dataset is cost-side only; credits/discounts presentation deferred. Synthetic traffic excluded; added explicit note + filter in SQL. Caleb Johnson (review): data_completeness_pct is helpful; can we make it deterministic and based on join success rate rather than non-null cost? Also add unmapped_model_id_count to quantify catalog drift. Nadia Rahman: Done—completeness is join_success_count / metered_request_count; added unmapped_model_id_count. Thomas Baird (review): Guardrail request—please fail the job if an unexpected dimension sneaks in (e.g., someone adds runtime_config to GROUP BY). Nadia Rahman: Added an assertion in the job config that the emitted schema matches the allowlist and added a unit test that simulates an extra column. Mei Lin (review): Late data window set to 3 days—can we make this configurable and document the tradeoff? Nadia Rahman: Added UNIT_ECON_RECOMPUTE_DAYS env var + doc comment; default remains 3. Approvals: Logan Wright approved after tier join fix; Rishi Malhotra approved after definition notes; Caleb Johnson approved after completeness changes; Thomas Baird approved after schema guardrail.

2025-02-12: Updates pushed; golden tests expanded; schema allowlist added
release_notes: Internal-only: adds `analytics.unit_econ_daily_v1` daily aggregate for blended $/1M output tokens by model/region/tier; job behind scheduler flag `enable_unit_econ_daily_v1`.
